binders: An arbitrary type Omega equipped with a measurable-space structure.
A measure mu on Omega equipped with the assumption that mu is a probability measure.
A real-valued function X : Omega -> Real.
A proof that X is Borel measurable.
hypotheses: The ambient measure mu has total mass one.
Within the first conclusion, the selector i is assumed not to be the constructor LocalDef006 corresponding to the centered linear-MGF criterion.
Within the second conclusion, LocalDef001 mu X is assumed: X is measurable and admits some positive real square-exponential scale.
conclusions: For every one of the four non-LocalDef006 selector values, LocalDef001 mu X holds if and only if there exists a real K > 0 satisfying the selected criterion. Concretely, the selected criteria are: the tail bound mu{|X| >= t} <= 2 exp(-t^2/K^2) for all t >= 0; real-power moment bounds integral |X|^p dmu <= (K sqrt(p))^p for every real p >= 1, with integrability; the bounded-parameter square-exponential bound integral exp(lambda^2 X^2) dmu <= exp(K^2 lambda^2) for |lambda| <= K^(-1), with integrability; and the single-scale square-exponential bound integral exp(X^2/K^2) dmu <= 2, with integrability. Each existential criterion may use its own K.
If LocalDef001 mu X holds, then the ENNReal infimum of all finite nonzero t for which exp(X^2/(t.toReal)^2) is integrable and has integral at most 2 is strictly below infinity.
Under the same premise, LocalDef003 mu X equals that infimum; this equality is a direct unfolding of LocalDef003 through LocalDef008.
mathematical_definitions: Let P(X) mean that X is measurable and there exists K > 0 such that exp(X^2/K^2) is integrable and its mu-integral is at most 2.
For t in ENNReal, let A_X(t) mean that X is measurable, t is nonzero and finite, exp(X^2/(t.toReal)^2) is integrable, and its mu-integral is at most 2.
Let rho(X) = inf {t in ENNReal | A_X(t)}. Both LocalDef003 and LocalDef008 denote rho(X).

The five selector branches are tail, real-power moment growth, bounded-parameter square-exponential, single-scale square-exponential, and centered linear-MGF; the last of these is LocalDef006 and is excluded from the claimed equivalence.
translation.proposition_plain_english: On any probability space, every measurable real-valued X satisfies the following packaged statement. Its positive single-scale square-exponential-integrability property P(X) is equivalent, separately and with an existentially chosen positive constant for each formulation, to each of four selected criteria: a subgaussian-looking tail estimate, real-power moment growth, a restricted-parameter square-exponential estimate, and the same single-scale square-exponential estimate. The fifth selector, a centered linear moment-generating-function estimate, is expressly excluded. Moreover, if P(X) holds, then the extended-nonnegative infimum rho(X) of all nonzero finite scales t satisfying integral exp(X^2/t^2) dmu <= 2 (with integrability) is finite, and LocalDef003 is equal to this infimum by definition.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The first equivalence is conditional on i != LocalDef006, so the proposition makes no equivalence claim for the centered linear-MGF criterion LocalDef009 and does not itself assert that X has mean zero.
The constants in the four existential formulations are not required to be equal or quantitatively comparable; each occurrence of Exists may choose a different positive K.
The target assumes measurability globally and also repeats it in LocalDef001 and the selected criteria, so several conjuncts are redundant under the outer hypothesis.
LocalDef001 contains an outer K > 0 requirement while LocalDef016 repeats K > 0 internally; LocalDef004's existential also adds K > 0 outside criteria that themselves already require positivity.
The infimum ranges only over ENNReal t with t != 0 and t != infinity. The real denominator is t.toReal, so these restrictions are essential to its intended positive finite-scale reading.

The equality involving LocalDef003 is definitionally tautological because LocalDef003 unfolds to LocalDef008, which is exactly the displayed infimum. Only the accompanying strict inequality below infinity adds content.
LocalDef017 literally bounds integral exp(lambda^2 X^2) by exp(K^2 lambda^2) only for |lambda| <= K^(-1); no alternate normalization or unstated constant comparison is encoded.
LocalDef019 quantifies over real p >= 1 and uses Real.rpow, not merely integer moments.
LocalDef018 uses Measure.real for event mass. In this target the probability-measure assumption ensures event measures are finite, avoiding the special toReal behavior at infinity.
Without the premise LocalDef001, the target does not claim the admissible-scale set is nonempty or that its infimum is finite.
ambiguities: The anonymized selector constructors have no source-level names, so descriptive labels such as tail, moment, bounded-parameter square-exponential, single-scale square-exponential, and linear-MGF are reconstructed solely from their branch definitions.
No intended conventional name for LocalDef001 or LocalDef003 is encoded; the translation therefore describes their formulas rather than assigning a source-specific norm or distribution class name.
